bio.text: Henry Cuellar represents Texas's 28th Congressional District, which includes parts of San Antonio and communities along the U.S.-Mexico border.

Born in Laredo, Texas, the eldest of eight children of migrant farmworkers, he attended Laredo Community College and Georgetown University, and holds a master's degree from Texas A&M International University and a J.D. and Ph.D. in government from the University of Texas at Austin.
He has practiced law and customs brokerage, taught at Texas A&M International University and Laredo College, and served as a Texas state representative and Texas Secretary of State.
